record.title: Define the next reusable tooling boundary from proven experiments
record.intent: Separate reusable capture transport evidence and verification components before implementation.
requirements: Map existing bench tools to reusable responsibilities and identify private controller duplication without publishing private configuration.
Define one bounded offline first implementation with acceptance criteria; avoid broad rewrites or changing pinned verifier dependencies during editorial cleanup.
acceptance: A reviewable composition proposal is linked from the current project entry point.
